Upstream author-reported debugging protocol derived from a failed investigation: falsifiable theories, trap-time evidence and generated-code verification. Method guidance, not a reproduced experiment.

Upstream SASS investigation of R2P masking tradeoffs on SM90; instruction-count changes and workload-specific performance are author-reported historical evidence, not local measurement.

Mask-derived sparse metadata generation separates partially masked, fully valid and fully masked tiles; varlen q requires cumulative M-block metadata. Read complete mask evaluation and boundary handling before skipping work.
Sparse metadata shapes/dtypes/devices, block-size normalization and backward traversal/deterministic ordering contracts; sparse mask is structured metadata, not an arbitrary index array.
Sparse tile traversal and producer-load scheduling across partial/full lists; pipeline carryover and tile/2CTA assumptions constrain legal traversal transformations.
Backward preprocessing computes dpsum/LSE representations and initializes accumulation storage; uses tile=self.tile_m for varlen padded offsets and explicit FP32 accumulation tensor contracts.

Blackwell backward resource allocation, shared/TMEM reuse, GQA FP32 gradient accumulation and semaphore ownership. Constructor rejects persistent scheduling and constrains head/CTA variants; forward design cannot be copied wholesale.
Sparse-metadata oracle tests distinguish valid boundary-tile full/partial classification differences from wrong interior block classifications; covers fixed and variable lengths.
